Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-11-04-batch-ba/2026-11-04-batch-ba.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: M-472: the refuse word no_permitted_gfa_base joins M-64's closed reason list (the M-428 form); no FSI cap gives not_evaluated:no_permitted_gfa_base on the mechanical rows, never zero.
decisions.recommendation: Operator answer (~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc2/open-questions.md, "Q-MECH0"): "a". Rule text: (a) Declare the refuse word `no_permitted_gfa_base` (the M-428 form, added to M-64's closed list). The mechanical outside-GFA rows become `if(attic_counted_x <= 0 m2; 0 m2; if(regulated(fsi); min(…); refuse(no_permitted_gfa_base)))`: no counted attic gives 0; an FSI cap gives "mechanical area: not yet stored" until the increment-3 night (Q-M1 b+); no FSI cap gives not_evaluated:no_permitted_gfa_base, disclosed "not applied" (M-472 "disclosed, not applied, never zero"; ATTIC-22, ATTIC-23). Red-first, lands with lane K's rows; table_version moves inside that re-pin. Record: ~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/MB-27/rows/Q-MECH0.md.

decisions.question: M-461: where slot 61 pitched_roof_slope_min is unregulated or not_applicable, the pitched form is offered; a stored threshold still refuses below it.
decisions.recommendation: Operator answer (~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc2/open-questions.md, "Q-T61"): "(a) Offer the pitched form in both cases (recommended). approved". Rule text: (a) Where slot 61 pitched_roof_slope_min is unregulated (RT by absence, ABS-8) or not_applicable, the pitched form is offered: both arms read `if(regulated(pitched_roof_slope_min) and roof_pitch_x < l2(pitched_roof_slope_min); refuse(pitched_form_not_offered); …)`. Where a threshold exists it still refuses below it (M-461). Built red-first by lane K (lock T61 + R2 OR-8 ii/iii), lands with lane K's rows before the axis night; table_version moves inside that commit's re-pin. Record: ~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/MB-27/rows/Q-T61.md.
decisions.operator_quote: (a) Offer the pitched form in both cases (recommended). approved

decisions.question: M-400: an option-less row that reads an option target is evaluated in the run of the row reading it and reported from the base run.

decisions.question: M-476: the increment-2 headline revision and the flat and pitched rows it reads default off in the switchboard until the axis night and R2 land.
decisions.recommendation: Operator answer (~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc2/open-questions.md, "Q-DEFAULT"): "Q-default a". Rule text: (a) The increment-2 headline revision (formula:gfa_max_m2:increment_2, and the flat and pitched rows it reads) defaults OFF in the switchboard. It is switched on, by one data change with its own prereg, after the axis night and the Layer 3 reader (R2) land. Until then golden-25 stays 29/29 and increment-1 results are unchanged (M-476: a switched-off revision reverts to the increment-1 formula). Increment 2's examples go green on the 25 at the switch-on.

decisions.question: M-476: D3 a is read literally: only a row whose own switch is off is hidden; a row that reads it is shown not_evaluated switched_off:<switch>.
decisions.recommendation: Operator answer (~/Buildo-scratch/mcbylaws/inc2/open-questions.md, "Q-K1"): "Q-k1a". Rule text: (a) D3 a is read literally: only the row whose own switch is off (and that has no increment-1 formula) is hidden. A row that only reads a switched-off row (e.g. gfa_pitched_m2 while the arms are off, or total_floor_area_pitched_*) is shown as not_evaluated with reason switched_off:<switch>. Principle 5 (not_evaluated always shown). Lane K's current filter already does this.
